run_persistence.detail: Runs persisted in SQLite via better-sqlite3. saveRunToDb/loadRunFromDb/listRunsFromDb exist.
run_persistence.gap: No startup hook to scan for incomplete runs and resume them

state_machine.detail: resumeFromEvents() exists but does not preserve branch name. RESUME_PENDING phase defined but no code transitions TO it.
state_machine.gap: RESUME_PENDING is unused. branch is set to null in resumeFromEvents.

github_reconciliation.detail: No code checks GitHub for existing PRs/branches before creating new ones. PR_CREATE phase always creates a new PR.
github_reconciliation.gap: No idempotency key, no pre-check for existing PR matching branch name

crash_recovery.detail: No fault injection hooks. No mechanism to detect that a run was interrupted between remote mutation and local checkpoint.
crash_recovery.gap: Complete absence of crash detection and resume logic

duplicate_prevention.detail: GitHub watcher has issue-level duplicate prevention. But PR_CREATE has no branch-level duplicate check.
duplicate_prevention.gap: After crash restart, PR_CREATE would create a second PR for the same branch

fault_injection.detail: No POSITRON_FAULT_INJECTION_POINT env var or equivalent mechanism
fault_injection.gap: No way to trigger controlled failure between remote mutation and local checkpoint
